mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, title, context_version, next_turn_no, created_at, updated_at, expires_at FROM batch.console_ai_conversation WHERE id = #{conversationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_conversation (id, tenant_id, owner_user_id, context_version, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{contextVersion}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, conversation_id, turn_no, context_version, prompt_text, response_text, turn_status, prompt_decision, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, estimated_cost_usd, created_at, completed_at FROM batch.console_ai_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND turn_status IN ('COMPLETE', 'FAILED') ORDER BY turn_no DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch.console_ai_turn (tenant_id, conversation_id, turn_no, context_version, prompt_text, turn_status) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{conversationId}, #{turnNo}, #{contextVersion}, #{promptText}, 'IN_PROGRESS')
mapper.update: UPDATE batch.console_ai_turn SET response_text = #{responseText}, turn_status = #{status}, prompt_decision = #{promptDecision}, model_name = #{modelName}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, estimated_cost_usd = #{estimatedCostUsd}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND turn_no = #{turnNo} AND turn_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM batch.tenant WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY tenant_id
